from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, json, sys
home=Path.home()
wake=home/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
states=home/".local/state/prediction-command-bus/tasks"
tid="DEV-PRED-CONT-NEXT-09bfdedea81fbfe9f3b3291e"
def load(p):
    try: return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception: return None
s=load(states/f"{tid}.json")
r=load(wake/"routes"/f"{tid}.json")
loc=[]
for n in ("outbox","inflight","sent"):
    d=wake/n
    if d.is_dir():
        for p in d.glob("*.json"):
            o=load(p)
            if isinstance(o,dict) and o.get("task_id")==tid: loc.append(n)
sys.path.insert(0,str(wake))
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("bridge_e018",wake/"bridge_server.py")
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(m)
b=m.base
cid=m.continuation.ids_for(tid)["continuation_id"]
vals=[
 f"status={s.get('status') if isinstance(s,dict) else None}",
 f"auto={s.get('auto_continue') if isinstance(s,dict) else None}",
 f"route={bool(r)}",
 f"binding={bool(b.route_binding_for_task(tid))}",
 f"loc={','.join(sorted(set(loc))) or 'none'}",
 f"ack={getattr(getattr(b,'ACK_HOOK',None),'__name__',None)}",
 f"release={getattr(getattr(b,'release_lease',None),'__name__',None)}",
 f"allows={m.continuation.source_allows_auto_continue(states,tid)}",
 f"cont={m.continuation.continuation_path(b.DATA_DIR,cid).is_file()}",
]
raise AssertionError("ACKPATH "+" ".join(vals))
